targetTypePolicy.digests: TEXT with explicit algorithm/domain/version; existing digest names alone do not prove safety.
targetTypePolicy.constraints: PK/UNIQUE/FK/CHECK/index/trigger semantics remain governed by the source inventory and separate D1 compatibility test matrix.

testCatalog.name: Field/schema parity
assertions: For every included field, D1 column name/type/nullability/default/PK/UNIQUE contract matches its mapping row.
EXTERNALIZE and DEFER fields are absent from D1 target v1; CONDITIONAL fields are absent unless their gate passes.
No source column is silently dropped or renamed without an explicit mapping.

testCatalog.name: KEEP preservation
assertions: Deterministic source-to-target mapping preserves values and ordering semantics.
All opaque refs are checked by the reference contract; no raw PII, URL, file path, bearer token, or runtime material is accepted.

testCatalog.name: Transform determinism
assertions: Transforms are deterministic for a fixed version and input.
A replay produces the same target value; source values never appear in target dumps, logs, or test snapshots.
Transform version is explicit and upgradeable without silent reinterpretation.

testCatalog.name: No secret/PII leakage
assertions: D1 dump, Worker request/response, logs, traces, backups, and failure diagnostics contain none of the externalized raw values.
Negative fixtures with signed URLs, bearer query strings, emails, free text, TOTP blobs, QR payloads, and raw edge materials are rejected or externalized.

testCatalog.name: External custody referential integrity
assertions: Every retained custody reference resolves to an approved custodian and lifecycle state.
Expiry, revocation, purge, and deletion propagate without copying raw material into D1.

testCatalog.name: Deferred feature gate
assertions: Deferred tables/rows are not copied in target v1.
Unexpected non-empty source rows fail closed and require a separate decision rather than silent omission.

testCatalog.name: Conditional inclusion gate
assertions: Conditional source presence/feature predicate is independently proven.
When false, target object/data is absent; when true, exact baseline fingerprint and approved migration path are required.

testCatalog.name: Opaque reference validation
assertions: Reject email, username, URL, absolute path, bearer token, raw UUID/password, credential material, and unbounded user text.
Validate namespace, stable identity, length, case, and owner relationship.

testCatalog.name: Existing digest verification
assertions: Verify digest algorithm, domain prefix, canonicalization, encoding, and source generation before retaining existing digest columns.
Never infer that a field is safe solely because its name ends in hash/digest/checksum.

testCatalog.name: Lease digest and fencing
assertions: Store only versioned lease-token digest; compare submitted raw token after applying the same domain-separated digest.
Preserve lease_generation, lease_until, state guards, expiry, and CAS/fencing behavior; stale generation/token must fail.
Old lease token must not appear in D1 or logs.

testCatalog.name: Idempotency digest and replay
assertions: Use a versioned domain-separated HMAC digest for raw idempotency keys; HMAC key is held outside D1 and shared only with authorized migration/Worker runtimes.
Same scope + same key + same request digest replays the same result; same scope + same key + different request digest fails with the existing conflict signature.
Preserve actor_scope/operation_type uniqueness and cross-domain separation; test key rotation/version behavior.

testCatalog.name: Versioned JSON allowlists
assertions: Every JSON field has an exact versioned schema and canonical serialization.
Recursively reject PII, URLs, tokens, passwords, private keys, raw UUID/password materials, arbitrary free text, unknown keys, oversized/deep structures.
Do not treat assertNoUnsafeFields() as a whole-table guarantee.

testCatalog.name: Timestamp semantics
assertions: Preserve TEXT ISO-UTC representation where source uses text; preserve INTEGER epoch-millisecond semantics for Ads Consent fields.
Do not globally coerce timestamps or use SQLite PRAGMA schema_version as schema identity; schemaDigest is the content fingerprint.
Test precision, timezone, ordering, nullability, and boundary comparisons.

testCatalog.name: Boolean representation
assertions: Keep booleans as INTEGER 0/1, not a new BOOLEAN storage type.
Enforce CHECK(value IN (0,1)) and reject null/out-of-domain values where source contract is NOT NULL.

testCatalog.name: Numeric bounds
assertions: Preserve INTEGER storage and source safe-integer limits; reject overflow, fractional, negative, and out-of-range values where disallowed.
Validate financial amounts, units, bytes, counters, versions, currency exponents, and percentages with domain-specific bounds.

testCatalog.name: Usage minimization and retention
assertions: Do not migrate unbounded raw samples before finite retention and workload policy are approved.
Compare permitted aggregates/rollups against synthetic source totals and verify purge/aggregation boundaries.

testCatalog.name: Ads Consent gate and semantics
assertions: Require ADS_CLICK_BINDING_ENABLED and independently verified production object presence.
Preserve ad_personalization=0 hard constraint and epoch-millisecond timestamps; create a versioned baseline fingerprint before migration.

testCatalog.name: TOTP credential custody
assertions: No encrypted TOTP blob enters D1, Worker payloads, logs, or backups.
Legacy enc:<base32> is not treated as encryption; require re-registration/re-protection or separate approved custody path before cutover.

testCatalog.name: Future auth schema gate
assertions: Do not infer production password/passkey rows from source DDL.
Password verifier migration requires approved hashing/reset/abuse controls; passkey migration allows public JWK only and rejects private JWK member d.

testCatalog.name: Financial ledger and saga invariants
assertions: Preserve coin lot conservation, wallet versioning, immutable ledger, holds/allocations, order snapshots, and financial integer bounds.
Payment settlement remains Payment → Wallet → Payment → Referral with idempotency and reconciliation; no false cross-store ACID claim.
Deferred remains one-D1 strong atomic boundary with Lease/outbox; subscription fulfillment remains D1 ↔ BWH durable command/receipt/reconciliation.

designContracts.name: Raw secret and PII custody
designContracts.decision: EXTERNALIZE raw lead email/message, subscription URL, TOTP blob, payment next-action URL, legacy checkout URL/QR and all edge credential-material files.
designContracts.notes: D1 retains only approved opaque refs/digests/lifecycle metadata. No new custody store is created in this phase.

designContracts.name: Lease token transform
designContracts.decision: Replace raw lease_token with lease_token_hash using SHA-256 over a domain-separated UTF-8 token; keep lease_generation, lease_until and state guards.
designContracts.notes: Source contract is 64 lowercase hex and relevant claim code uses randomBytes(32); verify every producer before freezing transform.

designContracts.name: Idempotency transform
designContracts.decision: Replace raw idempotency keys with versioned domain-separated HMAC-SHA-256 digests.
designContracts.notes: The HMAC key must live outside D1 and be consistently available to the one-time migration runner and future Worker. No key is created or stored by this task.

designContracts.name: JSON field allowlists
designContracts.decision: Transform metadata/event/payload JSON; keep controlled snapshots/policies only after exact schema validation.
designContracts.notes: Field-specific schemas and recursive sensitive-value rejection must be implemented before any data migration.

designContracts.name: Usage sample minimization
designContracts.decision: Conditional; require finite retention, aggregation decision, and query/workload justification.

designContracts.name: Future authentication tables
designContracts.decision: Defer password and passkey credential data; do not infer live rows from source DDL.
designContracts.notes: Whether an empty schema table is useful is a separate DDL decision; old TOTP enc:<base32> values require re-registration/re-protection or separately approved custody.

designContracts.name: Conditional objects
designContracts.decision: Ads Consent and Payment legacy archive remain conditional; no fabricated production presence.
designContracts.notes: Ads Consent requires feature gate and versioned baseline fingerprint; archive requires exact legacy schema fingerprint.

designContracts.name: Migration ledger
designContracts.decision: Keep source platform_schema_migrations business ledger and Wrangler d1_migrations as separate, coexisting ledgers.
designContracts.notes: Use complete Migration IDs; non-versioned baseline slices use Git Blob + schemaDigest fingerprints; never use PRAGMA schema_version as schema identity.

designContracts.name: Business transaction boundaries
designContracts.decision: Payment is a multi-stage saga with reconciliation; subscription fulfillment crosses D1 and BWH runtime; Deferred remains a single-D1 atomic/Lease/outbox flow.
designContracts.notes: Do not mechanically translate better-sqlite3 transaction callbacks to D1 batch or claim distributed ACID.
